verdict.rationale: Cooley publishes Cooley GO on its own pages, a named startup program offering free document generators, including a Delaware incorporation package and YC Safe documents. That is a free self-serve tool, though, not a stated fee arrangement for legal representation. Nothing in the evidence describes deferred fees, fixed-fee formation pricing or engagement terms for startup clients. Missing for 10: deferred-fee terms, fixed-fee formation pricing, published engagement terms for a startup legal-services program, independent corroboration of startup fee terms.
